fieldValues.title: clerk claim refuses an issue that an open PR only mentions
fieldValues.summary: clerk claim refused srs-context#113 with 'an open PR already references it (srs-context#120)': PR #120 only mentioned #113 in prose ('not counted yet (srs-context#113)'). The collision check (refersTo in clerk lib/practice/claim.mjs) treats any #n in a PR's title or body as that PR working on the issue, so a PR that points at its successor blocks the successor's claim.
evidence: clerk claim srs-context#113, 2026-10-30 ~10:45 UTC: refused, 'an open PR already references it (srs-context#120)'
Worked round by rewriting #113 and #114 in PR #120's body as full URLs; the claim then succeeded
fieldValues.body:
- A holon's PRs routinely name the next items in their chain, so this stops every holon at each step.
- Likely remedy: count only closing keywords (Closes/Fixes/Resolves #n) or a head branch named n-*, not a bare mention.
